_meta.description: Published inference benchmark data, mostly vLLM. Community-contributed. Two entries are llama.cpp single-stream numbers — check each entry's `note` for the engine before treating it as a vLLM measurement. See CONTRIBUTING.md to add entries.

schema.tokS: Throughput in tokens/sec — interpret according to `mode`
schema.mode: REQUIRED. 'single' = one request at a time (per-user decode speed). 'batch' = aggregate across all concurrent requests. These differ by 50-100x; the tool compares each against the matching estimate and never mixes them.
schema.estimated: true if this number was extrapolated rather than measured on the stated hardware. Omit or false for real measurements.
schema.note: Conditions: model name, precision, batch/single, context length
schema.prec: Precision used: bf16, fp8, q4, int4
schema.url: Link to original benchmark. Empty string means unverifiable — treat with suspicion.

32b-a100-80.note: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, BF16 — scaled from smaller models, not measured

8b-h100-80.note: Llama 8B, BF16, batch throughput, vLLM v0.6+

27b-h100-80.note: Gemma 27B class, BF16 — no published source, treat as rough

70b-h100-80.note: Llama 70B, BF16, 2xH100 TP=2 — no published source, treat as rough

27b-b200-192.note: Qwen 3.5 27B FP8, single B200, vLLM+MTP, worst-case (no prefix cache)

7b-a100-40.note: ~75% of A100 80GB (less KV headroom for batching) — not measured

8b-a100-40.note: ~75% of A100 80GB (less KV headroom for batching) — not measured

8b-rtx4090-24.note: Q4_K_XL, 16K ctx, single-user decode, llama.cpp (not vLLM)
